# E0.3: NaN in inference contexts (audit + delete vs mask)

Status: planned
Owner: Naresh
Dates: planned 2026-10-27 / started - / finished -

---

## Part A. Written BEFORE the run (do not edit after the run starts)

**Gap / phase:** Phase 0, foundations (inference); prerequisite of G6.

**Background.** `ft3_core.forecast_left_padded` deletes NaNs (`y = y[np.isfinite(y)]`), which shifts the seasonal phase after a gap.
The scorers first run `fill_season` (gaps -> the value one season back, else the last value; leading NaNs dropped). After
`fill_season` only an ALL-NaN series still holds NaN, so in today's scoring the deletion should almost never fire (to be measured).
In groups ON mode NaNs also reach inference through covariates: `_lane_array` forward-fills interior NaNs of every group lane, and
`forecast_groups` forward-fills NaNs in the known future.

**Hypothesis (one sentence):** after `fill_season` almost no NaN reaches `forecast_left_padded`, and without `fill_season`, deleting
NaNs costs measurably more than masking them.

**Change (exact config diff against B0):**
```
generator version: n/a (no training)
switches:          n/a
anything else:     inference variants (tideforge/eval/nan_variants.py, swapped in memory for one scoring run, originals restored):
  baseline       fill_season + forecast_left_padded (deletes NaN) + _lane_array (forward-fills)  = E0.2, reused, not re-scored
  nofill_delete  leading NaNs dropped only, interior NaNs kept + forecast_left_padded deletes them  (isolates the deletion effect)
  nofill_mask    leading NaNs dropped only; interior NaNs -> value 0, mask False, in forecast_left_padded and in _lane_array
```

**Important limit.** ft3_main never saw single masked points inside a series in training: its only masked inputs were left padding
and whole CPM-hidden patches, and missing runs in the generator are forward-filled (`_L_corruption`). So nofill_mask can only show the
size of the deletion effect for THIS model; it cannot show whether masking helps a model trained with masks. That is G6.

**Run id(s):** checkpoint names `ft3mainnfdel`, `ft3mainnfmask`; tags `<name>_s0` (OFF) and `<name>on_s0` (ON). The audit:
`nan_audit.csv` in the evaluation root.

**What is measured:**
1. Audit (no model, CPU), per fev task and TIME dataset/term: series, context values (last 8192), leading and interior NaNs
   before fill, NaNs after fill (= what reaches forecast_left_padded), all-NaN series, values the deletion would remove, and for
   groups ON the NaNs in past covariates, known-covariate context and known future.
2. Scores of nofill_delete and nofill_mask in both modes, next to baseline (E0.2): fev skill, TIME MASE / CRPS, and per task the
   change on the tasks that have interior NaNs.

**Expected direction and rough size:** audit: NaN after fill ~ 0 outside all-NaN series. Scores: nofill_delete worse than baseline on
tasks with gaps; nofill_mask between the two or close to baseline. Size unknown (guess: under 1 fev point overall, larger on the
few tasks with many gaps).

**Pass rule:** "record the change" (EXPERIMENTS.md). The audit table is complete for every task; both variants are scored in both
modes. No decision is taken on fev / TIME from this experiment; it only says how much NaN handling matters for ft3_main and which
inference to use until G6.

**What would make this a failure:** the audit misses tasks, or a variant run fails on some tasks (reported, not hidden).

**Cost estimate:** audit: CPU, under 1 h (estimate). Scoring: two variants x two modes, about 2 x E0.2 = ~4 GPU-hours (estimate).

**Looks:** the audit = 1 LOOKS.md row ("data only, no model scored"); scoring = 4 rows per variant (fev / TIME x ON / OFF).

## Part B. Written AFTER the run

**What actually ran** (anything that differed from Part A, and why):
- Audit: `e03_nan.sh audit` on Perlmutter, 2026-10-27 ($TF_ROOT/eval_t0/eval/nan_audit.csv, log $TF_ROOT/logs/e03_audit.log).
- Scoring: not run yet (low priority, owner). It runs as a batch job, scripts/perlmutter/e03_score.sbatch (generated by
  tideforge/slurm.py). Because E0.2's full scoring did not run in tideforge's root (E0.2 used tidemark's run), the job also
  scores the baseline, one GPU per variant.

**Results:**

Audit summary (target contexts, last 8,192 points, as the scorers cut them):

| Benchmark | Tasks | Tasks with interior NaN | Interior NaN | NaN after fill | All-NaN series | Covariate NaN (groups ON) |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| fev | 100 ok | 15 | 1,070,612 of 350,862,231 values | 30,820, all in gvar | 230 | 35,998,909 |
| TIME | 98 ok | 35 | 5,339,254 of 705,711,921 values | 0 | 0 | 0 (no covariates) |

- After fill_season, NaN reach the model in one fev task only: gvar (30,820 values). fill_season leaves NaN only in series
  that are NaN throughout; the other fev tasks have no NaN after fill, so the 230 all-NaN series and gvar's 30,820 NaN should
  be the same thing (~134 values per series). To be confirmed from gvar's row:
  `python -m tideforge.eval.nan_audit --report $TF_ROOT/eval_t0/eval/nan_audit.csv` (prints NaN after fill and all-NaN
  series per task, and any all-NaN series in tasks without NaN after fill).
- So with today's scoring, deletion (forecast_left_padded dropping NaN) touches only those all-NaN series. The interior gaps
  of the other 50 tasks are filled one season back before the model sees them. The open question for G6 is fill vs mask,
  not deletion; nofill_delete / nofill_mask measure what the fill is worth and what masking would give instead.
- The 36M covariate NaN (groups ON, fev only): the breakdown by task, past vs known and context vs horizon is printed by the
  same --report from the existing CSV. The audit now also splits covariate NaN into leading / interior / all-NaN series and
  names the columns; that needs a fev-only rerun of the audit (about the fev part of the first run; no GPU). How groups ON
  handles them today (ft3_core): in a context lane, NaN before a covariate's first value is unobserved (mask 0, like left
  padding); later NaN are forward-filled and marked observed (_lane_array); NaN in a known covariate's future are
  forward-filled from its last value inside forecast_groups. Past covariates have no horizon values in the audit (they are
  history only), so none of the 36M are "past-only covariates over the horizon".

Scores: pending (batch job).

| Variant | fev ON | fev OFF | TIME MASE ON | TIME MASE OFF | TIME CRPS ON | TIME CRPS OFF |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| baseline | | | | | | |
| nofill_delete | | | | | | |
